citations.quote: On infrastructure she is the person I would want on any Kubernetes or Terraform problem, and the drain controller was genuinely clever work.
Twelve services now provision through the shared modules with per-environment state.
Cloud spend for the platform estate fell from $2.41M to $1.49M over the fiscal year, a 38% reduction.
Median time to recovery across platform incidents moved from 45 minutes to 22 over the half.

rationale: The evidence supports Kubernetes, Terraform and cost engineering (a 38% spend reduction, 180 pod specs rightsized, a referee endorsement) and shows reliability work such as failover game days, but the reliability results are credited mainly to a runbook index and direct team paging rather than to this candidate, and the CKA certification has expired, so the claim is supported in part rather than in full.
